# spo_tenant (Data Source)

Look up an existing Tenant object. Set identity to select it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spo_tenant" "current" {}

output "sharing_capability" {
  value = data.spo_tenant.current.sharing_capability
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
